mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID , RECRUITMENT_NO , SCRAB_RECUITMENT_DATE FROM SCRAB_RECRUITMENT

SELECT sr.USER_ID, sr.RECRUITMENT_NO, sr.SCRAB_RECUITMENT_DATE, r.RECRUITMENT_NO AS recruitment_recruitmentNo, r.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, r.REC_CONTENT, r.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, r.RECRUITMENT_SALARY, r.WELFARE, c.COM_NAME FROM SCRAB_RECRUITMENT sr JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE r ON sr.RECRUITMENT_NO = r.RECRUITMENT_NO JOIN COMPANY c ON r.USER_ID = c.USER_ID WHERE sr.USER_ID = #{userId}
